label: Langtang Lirung collapse (26 Aug 2026)
subtitle: Clear-sky debris flood - the blind spot
mechanism: Ice-rock avalanche, no rainfall precursor, seismically detectable
teaches: A rainfall-only engine stays green across the entire Trishuli corridor while the surge is already moving. Dual-channel detects the detachment at the slope and hands every downstream district an arrival countdown.
